description: Defines classes and interfaces for managing OpenGL ES 3 Vertex Array Objects, including state management, dirty bit tracking, and implementation details.

classes.name: VertexArray
classes.description: Represents a GLES 3 Vertex Array Object, manages state, dirty bits, and implementation interactions.

classes.name: VertexArrayState
classes.description: Holds the state of a Vertex Array, including attributes, bindings, and validation masks.

classes.name: IndexRangeCache
classes.description: Caches index ranges for draw calls to optimize repeated index range queries.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the vertex array.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the vertex array.

methods.name: getVertexBinding
methods.description: Retrieves a vertex binding by index.

methods.name: getVertexAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a vertex attribute by index.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from the vertex array.

methods.name: setVertexAttribDivisor
methods.description: Sets the divisor for a vertex attribute.

methods.name: enableAttribute
methods.description: Enables or disables a vertex attribute.

methods.name: setVertexAttribPointer
methods.description: Defines an array of vertex attribute data.

methods.name: setVertexAttribIPointer
methods.description: Defines an array of integer vertex attribute data.

methods.name: setVertexAttribFormat
methods.description: Specifies the format of a vertex attribute.

methods.name: bindVertexBuffer
methods.description: Binds a buffer to a vertex buffer binding point.

methods.name: setVertexAttribBinding
methods.description: Associates a vertex attribute with a binding point.

methods.name: setVertexBindingDivisor
methods.description: Sets the divisor for a vertex buffer binding.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the vertex array state with the underlying implementation.

methods.name: hasAnyDirtyBit
methods.description: Checks if any dirty bits are set.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Retrieves the index range for draw calls, with caching.
